# Burger Point — burgerpoint.co.in
> Best fast food restaurant in Jankipuram, Lucknow. Burgers, momos, indo-chinese, pizza, pasta, shakes and more. Dine-in, takeaway and home delivery.

## About
Burger Point is a vegetarian fast food restaurant located in Jankipuram, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India.
Address: 60 Feet Road, Jankipuram, Lucknow, UP 226021
Phone: +91-9194008822
Hours: Monday–Sunday 11:00 AM – 10:30 PM
Cuisines: Burgers, Momos, Indo-Chinese, Pizza, Pasta, Shakes

## Ordering
- Online ordering available at https://www.burgerpoint.co.in/
- Dine-in: scan table QR code or enter table number on the website
- Takeaway: select takeaway on the website, enter name and phone
- Delivery: available within 5 km of Jankipuram; enter address and live location on the website

## Menu Highlights
- Burgers: Smash Burger, Crispy Chicken Burger, Double Patty, Zinger, Veg Aloo Tikki Burger
- Momos: Steamed, Fried, Pan-Fried, Kurkure
- Indo-Chinese: Veg/Chicken Chowmein, Schezwan Noodles, Manchurian, Fried Rice
- Pizza: Margherita, Chicken Pizza
- Pasta: Arrabbiata, Cheesy White Sauce
- Sides: Loaded Cheese Fries, Peri Peri Fries, Spring Rolls
- Drinks: Chocolate Shake, Oreo Shake, Cold Coffee, Mocktails

## Table Reservations
Book a table at https://www.burgerpoint.co.in/#reservation

## Technical
- This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) installable from the browser
- API: no public API available; ordering is through the website only
- Robots: https://www.burgerpoint.co.in/robots.txt
